correctness.rationale: Reconstructed parameter h=dim(W∩U) for W=imF and U=imE with E projection U⊕K. For fixed rank-r E, there are [n r]_q q^{r(n-r)} possibilities. rank(EF)=p enforces dim(W∩K)=s-p. First choose A=W∩U and B=W∩K, then W/(A⊕B) is graph of a rank c=p-h isomorphism between c-subspaces in U/A,K/B: factor [r h]_q[n-r s-p]_q[r-h c]_q[n-r-s+p c]_q GL_q(c). For fixed W, F kernels are complements L to W, parameterized by φ:V/W→W; rank(FE)=t iff induced φ on π(U)→W/A has rank t-h, contributing R_q(s-h,r-h;t-h) q^{h(r-h)+s(n-s-r+h)}. All dimension constraints are stated and ensure nonnegative exponents. Independent Python brute force enumerated all idempotents and both ordered product ranks for (q,n)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3): all 64,196,3364 ordered pairs and every possible rank quadruple matched the formula. Swapping E,F gives (r,s,p,t)↔(s,r,t,p); independent summation over all p,t gives product of idempotent rank counts.
